name: Chiusi (Italy)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Chiusi (a yellow lion on white above a blue bar) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Chiusi, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Chiusi arms — yellow lion on white above a blue bar, crowned, within branches
